_comment: Ratchet for `homelab mutants`: undetected (survived + untested) mutants per file. Counts may be lowered or removed, never added or raised by hand. Regenerate with `homelab mutants --update-baseline` after an improvement. Scope lives in [tool.mutmut].only_mutate in pyproject.toml.
_measured: Serial figures (--max-children 1), which is the default and the only mode --update-baseline accepts. Each of the six was reproduced exactly on back-to-back fresh sweeps, so this baseline is exact and needs no drift tolerance. A parallel sweep will report LOWER numbers -- that is cross-child interference, not an improvement, and the gate will call it 'improved' rather than fail. Do not ratchet those in.
_history: Two artifacts inflated every figure recorded before 2026-09-12 and both credited an environmental failure as a detection. (1) mutmut's per-mutant CPU cap raises SIGXCPU and scores the timeout as killed; fixed by [tool.mutmut].timeout_multiplier. (2) Concurrent children share one mutants/ tree, so a mutant writing under it fails an unrelated child's test; fixed by defaulting to serial. Do not compare against any earlier number.
